body.title: urlutil: keep trailing slash when joining URLs
body.body:
<!--  Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

`URLJoin` loses the trailing slash because `path.Join` cleans its result. This restores the slash whenever the last element of the joined path (the base path, if no extra paths are given) ended with one, so both `URLJoin("http://example.com/repo", "charts/")` and `URLJoin("http://example.com/repo/")` keep the slash.

Fixes #10

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

None.

commit.message:
urlutil: keep trailing slash when joining URLs

Restore the trailing slash that path.Join removes if the last element of the joined path ended with one. This also covers a base URL with a trailing slash and no extra paths.

items.title: fix(urlutil): preserve trailing slash in URLJoin
items.body:
<!--  Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

`URLJoin` builds its result with `path.Join`, which cleans the path and removes any trailing `/`. `URLJoin("https://example.com/repo", "charts/")` therefore returned `https://example.com/repo/charts`. This keeps the trailing slash when the last path component ends with one.

Fixes #10

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Only the last component is considered; slashes on intermediate components are still cleaned as before.
